inference: complete native parameter namespaces for ASR-HF, TTS 1.5B, and Realtime 0.5B
ASR causal speech encoders, multimodal projection, greedy generation, and structured decoding
TTS acoustic and semantic codecs, Qwen2 backbones, diffusion head, and DPM-Solver stages
strict single and sharded Safetensors loading and portable export
training: ASR masked causal-token objective with the published frozen speech encoders
TTS 1.5B masked causal-token and v-prediction diffusion objectives with published frozen codecs
full trainability of every component that the published forward permits
limitations: Microsoft did not publish a raw-data TTS training serializer, dataset recipe, optimizer recipe, or benchmark protocol; VoiceHub requires explicit preprocessed segment and latent masks.
Realtime 0.5B publishes no unified training forward and is rejected for fine-tuning.
Realtime low-level stages are exposed, but high-level streaming parity is not claimed until chunk and cache differential tests are complete.
No corpus-level accuracy, speaker-similarity, latency, or audio-quality improvement is claimed.

security_boundary.runtime_dependencies: PyTorch, the Python standard library, and VoiceHub only
security_boundary.snapshot_policy: Official Hub artifacts resolve to immutable commits and all indexed shard headers are reconciled before any tensor assignment.
